title: Sample-Rate Match
text: Upsample two signals to common rate, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of each input signal, {Output samples per frame} sets the number of samples output per frame, {Output sample rate options} sets the options for output sample rate and {Output sample rate (Hz)} sets the output signal sample. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In1
ports.summary: First input signal column vector | matrix

ports.name: In2
ports.summary: Second input signal column vector | matrix

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of each input signal [1 2]*1e6 (default) | 2-element vector

params.name: Output samples per frame
params.values: Number of samples output per frame 1000 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output sample rate options
params.values: Options for output sample rate Auto (default) | Specify via property

params.name: Output sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Output signal sample rate 2e6 (default) | positive scalar
